clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, the hunt tests a Horde champion against three legendary predators. Felling Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon proves strength, tenacity, and primal prowess in a contested forest.

Senani Thunderheart tests travelers among the Horde forces in Ashenvale. Her hunt tests more than loyalty to the warchief; it asks whether a hunter understands survival in the wild. Three legendary predators are its quarry: the bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the fierce hippogryph Sharptalon. Felling all three and securing their trophies proves a hunter's blood runs true.

For the tauren, hunting is a sacred act of balance and respect, even in an active warfront. Overcoming Ashenvale's greatest terrors honors the spirits of the land and earns a hunter the ancestral blessings of Thunderheart. A formal commendation and token of favor mark the hunt's end, while the champion's reputation spreads throughout the forest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt. You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!
Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today. May your ancestors watch over you!
